_comment: SPLADE post-process parity golden (synthetic logits, batch=1, seq=2, vocab=4). Locks the lockstep contract: activation ln(1+max(0,x)), max-pool over seq with attention mask, >0 zero-suppression, ascending-token-id canonical serialization at 4 decimal places. The P5.2 publisher MUST reproduce expected_sha256 for the same logits. End-to-end real-model (Splade_PP_en_v1) parity between the publisher output and the native query path is the separate release gate.
